text:
About
This repository documents the procedures used to test the databraryr R package.

title: User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for databraryr
text:
Set-up

API credentials
Databrary permits secure API access only to specifically authorized users.
Detailed information about the application process may be found here.


Install package
Install the databraryr package from GitHub.
remotes::install_github(repo = "NYU-Databrary/databraryr", ref = "development")






Important



Note that this tests the development branch.




Add credentials to .Renviron
Run usethis::edit_r_environ('user')
